label: KODAK AEROCOLOR IV 2460 (ISO A 125)
source: Eastman Kodak Company technical data AS-2652, KODAK AEROCOLOR IV Negative Film 2460 (New 10-09), curves read from the PDF's vector paths (pages 5-6)

spectral_sensitivity.unit: log10 sensitivity (reciprocal exposure, erg/cm2, for density 0.3 above D-min)

notes: Approximate digitization; not supplied or endorsed by Eastman Kodak Company. Sensitometry x = (log H - Log H Ref) / log10(2), Log H Ref -0.991 lux-seconds (see below; not printed on the chart); density is Status M including base, made monotone by running maximum. Spectral sensitivity kept only where the curve is drawn on the chart; wavelengths where a curve is not drawn are omitted, so a channel's wavelength list can be non-contiguous. Individual dye curves not published; dye_density holds only the published midscale neutral and minimum density curves. Aerial film without integral colour masking (datasheet page 1). Characteristic curves: the 'Developed for Low Contrast' chart (page 6), which is standard Process C-41 timing: 3'15" dev time (or Process AN-6, 137 s, 38.9 C), Exposure Daylight, Densitometry Status M; this is the development the datasheet's nominal speed EAFS / ISO A 125 is based on (push value 4, approx. contrast 0.90); the low- and medium-contrast charts are not used. The datasheet prints no Log H Ref, grey-card aim or mid-grey point: INTERPRETED, not from the datasheet: Log H Ref chosen so that green density at 0 stop sits 0.735 above green D-min, the mean of ten Kodak C-41 negatives in this project (Gold 200, UltraMax 400, Ektar 100, Portra 160/400/800/160NC/160VC, Pro Image 100, Supra 100; spread 0.061). Cross-check: Kodak's printed Log H Ref for ISO 100 C-41 stocks (-0.84) scaled to the aerial speed 125 gives -0.937, 0.18 stop away. Axes calibrated from the drawn tick marks (log H -3.0 and 0.0, density 1.0 and 3.0), which agree with the frame (log H -4.0 to 1.0, density 0.0 to 4.0). Spectral sensitivity (page 5): Process AN-6, effective exposure 1/25 s, Status M, density 0.3 above D-min; this chart's log-sensitivity axis runs 0.0 to 4.0, calibrated from the 1.0 and 3.0 grid lines. Spectral dye density (page 6): typical densities for a midscale neutral subject and D-min (no process line), charted 400-750 nm. RMS granularity 15.5 is the published value for C-41 5:15 dev time (read at a net green diffuse density of 1.0 with a 48-micrometre aperture); 8.5 (3:15) and 13 (4:15) belong to the lower-contrast developments. No Print Grain Index is published. The MTF chart (Process AN-6) is not digitized.
